import jobs

def test_basic_dedup():
    """Test basic deduplication by (source, source_id) - first occurrence wins."""
    rows = [
        {'title': 'Job A', 'source': 'src1', 'source_id': '1'},
        {'title': 'Job A', 'source': 'src1', 'source_id': '1'},  # duplicate
        {'title': 'Job B', 'source': 'src1', 'source_id': '2'},
    ]
    result = jobs.unique_jobs(rows)
    assert len(result) == 2, f"Expected 2 rows, got {len(result)}"
    assert result[0]['title'] == 'Job A'
    assert result[1]['title'] == 'Job B'

def test_different_sources_same_id():
    """Test that different sources with same source_id are not merged."""
    rows = [
        {'title': 'Job X', 'source': 'src1', 'source_id': '1'},
        {'title': 'Job Y', 'source': 'src2', 'source_id': '1'},  # different source
    ]
    result = jobs.unique_jobs(rows)
    assert len(result) == 2, f"Expected 2 rows, got {len(result)}"
    assert any(r['title'] == 'Job X' for r in result), "Missing Job X"
    assert any(r['title'] == 'Job Y' for r in result), "Missing Job Y"

def test_empty_source_id():
    """Test that rows with empty source_id are kept separately."""
    rows = [
        {'title': 'Job P', 'source': 'src1', 'source_id': ''},
        {'title': 'Job Q', 'source': 'src1', 'source_id': ''},  # different title, same empty source_id
    ]
    result = jobs.unique_jobs(rows)
    assert len(result) == 2, f"Expected 2 rows, got {len(result)}"

def test_none_source_id():
    """Test that rows with None source_id are kept separately."""
    rows = [
        {'title': 'Job R', 'source': 'src1', 'source_id': None},
        {'title': 'Job S', 'source': 'src1', 'source_id': None},  # different title
    ]
    result = jobs.unique_jobs(rows)
    assert len(result) == 2, f"Expected 2 rows, got {len(result)}"

def test_no_mutation():
    """Test that input is not mutated."""
    rows = [
        {'title': 'Job T', 'source': 'src1', 'source_id': '1'},
    ]
    original = [{'title': 'Job T', 'source': 'src1', 'source_id': '1'}]
    result = jobs.unique_jobs(rows)
    assert rows == original, "Input was mutated"

def test_maintain_order():
    """Test that first occurrence is preserved in order."""
    rows = [
        {'title': 'A', 'source': 'src1', 'source_id': '1'},
        {'title': 'B', 'source': 'src1', 'source_id': '2'},
        {'title': 'A', 'source': 'src1', 'source_id': '1'},  # duplicate of first
    ]
    result = jobs.unique_jobs(rows)
    assert len(result) == 2, f"Expected 2 rows, got {len(result)}"
    assert result[0]['title'] == 'A'
    assert result[1]['title'] == 'B'

if __name__ == '__main__':
    test_basic_dedup()
    print("test_basic_dedup passed")
    test_different_sources_same_id()
    print("test_different_sources_same_id passed")
    test_empty_source_id()
    print("test_empty_source_id passed")
    test_none_source_id()
    print("test_none_source_id passed")
    test_no_mutation()
    print("test_no_mutation passed")
    test_maintain_order()
    print("test_maintain_order passed")
    print("All tests passed!")
